contract.text: The wire delivery corrects the datum, derives identity from the complete asset set, preserves the custody and refund obligations, and documents every copy. Its frozen local gate, five reviews and exact-head continuous integration checks are complete. The epic owner split the conformance row, registration and unregistered-row control into a separate residual dependent on the description language. That obligation remains required and is not satisfied by this delivery. Reference selection remains uncovered, existing authority holds remain held, and the naming mirror is unchanged. Task checks record delivery and review readiness; acceptance and merge remain with the epic owner.

transferred-residual.text: The new conformance row for the refund-only absent custody wire, its registration at the actual continuous integration judgment sites, and an executed unregistered-row control transfer undiminished to the epic owner. They remain required pending the description language landing and authorization for a separate issue. This delivery does not complete, waive, or satisfy that residual.

evidence-limits.text: The wrong-reference control reached edge four and still passed, so reference selection remains a named uncovered consumer. The bound Lean model constrains custody, token, and refund obligations but does not model booking reference-input identity. The existing authority holds remain held, naming stays excluded and unchanged, and the final task-stamp commit changes delivery metadata only.
